audience: shop owners who run their tills and stock in SalesPlay POS

useCases.title: Find products low on stock
useCases.text: List the shops, then the inventory levels in one or more shops with their products.

useCases.title: Review the receipts of a shop
useCases.text: List the receipts of a shop and the payment types they use.

useCases.title: Add a product to the listed shops
useCases.text: Create a product with its cost for the listed shops. Stock tracking stays off by default.

useCases.title: Set the stock of a product in a shop
useCases.text: Set the stock quantity of products in one or more shops. Repeating the call gives the same result.
